preconditions.expression: root is None or isinstance(root, TreeNode)
preconditions.description: The input root must be either None or a valid TreeNode instance.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node, TreeNode) for node in [root] + [node.left for node in [root] if node] + [node.right for node in [root] if node]) if root is not None
preconditions.description: All nodes in the tree must be valid TreeNode instances with left and right attributes.

postconditions.expression: return_value is None or isinstance(return_value, TreeNode)
postconditions.description: The function returns either None or a valid TreeNode, which is the head of the DLL.

postconditions.expression: all(node.left is None or node.right is None for node in [return_value] + [node.right for node in [return_value] if node]) if return_value is not None
postconditions.description: The returned DLL is a valid doubly linked list where each node's left and right pointers are used as previous and next pointers, respectively.

postconditions.expression: all(node.left is None or node.right is None for node in [return_value] + [node.right for node in [return_value] if node]) if return_value is not None and all(node.left is None or node.right is None for node in [return_value] + [node.right for node in [return_value] if node])
postconditions.description: The DLL contains exactly the leaf nodes of the original tree, ordered from leftmost to rightmost.

postconditions.expression: all(node.left is None or node.right is None for node in [return_value] + [node.right for node in [return_value] if node]) if return_value is not None and all(node.left is None or node.right is None for node in [return_value] + [node.right for node in [return_value] if node]) and all(node.left is None or node.right is None for node in [return_value] + [node.right for node in [return_value] if node])
postconditions.description: The original tree is modified in-place such that all leaf nodes are removed and their left/right pointers are repurposed to form the DLL.
